data.exact_reserve_text: the 2018 Account suffered a prior year adverse movement of 2.2% points from the 2017 Account AXA/XL Whole Account Quota Share contract. The final result for the 2018 Account is a loss as a percentage of capacity of 22.3%, which includes a prior year deficit of 2.1% of capacity. The 2019 Year of Account has unfortunately suffered a material loss from Typhoon Hagibis and following pricing reviews of the casualty account ultimate loss ratios have been reassessed upwards by Asta, which has been validated by Chord Re's approach to pricing the 2020 renewals.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced an overall strengthening of prior year reserves in 2020. The 2018 year of account suffered an adverse movement, including a prior year deficit related to the 2017 AXA/XL Whole Account Quota Share contract. The 2019 year of account also saw ultimate loss ratios reassessed upwards, contributing to further strengthening, particularly due to a material loss from Typhoon Hagibis. Other significant events impacting prior years included Hurricane Michael, Typhoons Jebi, Trami, Mangkhut, Californian Wildfires, and the NiSource Massachusetts Gas Explosion.

data.data_quality_notes: The Claims Development Table on page 18 is presented in GBP (GBP '000) while the main financial statements are in USD ($'000). The figures in the claims development table are inconsistent with the USD balance sheet when converted using the stated exchange rates, making it unreliable for calculating prior year development in USD. Therefore, prior year development amount and percentage are not quantified, but the direction is inferred from narrative text.
